I added `frontend(path, *, directory, name=None)` to both `FastAPI` (`fastapi/applications.py`) and `APIRouter` (`fastapi/routing.py`). It mounts a `StaticFiles(directory=..., html=True)` at the given path, so `app.frontend("/", directory="dist")` serves `index.html` at `/`.

I checked this with a quick manual run: `app.frontend("/")` returned 200 with the index page, and a router mounted at `/x` and included in an app returned 200 for `/x/`. I did not run the repo's test suite or add tests, and I did not add documentation.
